# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework (OUTER). Generated by gen_territory_outer.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Hardcoded hooks append to the existing handlers.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_tw_monthly_pulse oe_tw_title_sweep } }
yearly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_tw_yearly_pulse } }
on_location_changed_owner = { on_actions = { oe_tw_former_owner_changed } }
on_new_ruler = { on_actions = { oe_tw_new_ruler } }
on_ruler_death = { on_actions = { oe_tw_ruler_death } }

# Ranks: first month of a game or save, again 2 months later (the Roman World assigns its statuses in its own
# monthly tick), then every 6 months.
oe_tw_monthly_pulse = {
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_rank_timer } }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_rank_init } }
            set_variable = oe_tw_rank_init
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_rank_timer months = 2 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tw_rank_timer months = 6 } }
        oe_tw_rank_refresh = yes
    }
}
oe_tw_yearly_pulse = {
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    effect = {
        oe_tw_former_yearly = yes
        if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } oe_tw_ai_yearly = yes }
    }
}
# root = location. A marked former province that passes to anyone but BYZ has been lost; a returned location
# that is lost again before its event drops out of that event.
oe_tw_former_owner_changed = {
    trigger = {
        OR = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province has_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending }
        NOT = { owner ?= { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    effect = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province } set_variable = oe_tw_former_lost }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending } remove_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending }
    }
}
# root = country.
oe_tw_new_ruler = {
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled }
    effect = { oe_tw_on_new_ruler = yes }
}
# root = country (r10). The titled ruler died: the dignity lapses at once.
oe_tw_ruler_death = {
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled }
    effect = { oe_tw_on_ruler_death = yes }
}
# BYZ, monthly (r10). r10 found a title kept after its holder died; every titled country follows its current ruler again.
oe_tw_title_sweep = {
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
    effect = { every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled } oe_tw_on_new_ruler = yes } }
}
